subject: Repurpose senior infra req to Edge Inference — comp band & approvals
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Repurpose senior infra req to Edge Inference — comp band & approvals

Rachel / Neha —

Product has an urgent ask to ship Edge Inference runtime features (latency optimizations for on-device KV cache). We currently have an open Senior Infra Engineer req (REQ-824) in the hiring queue with no active starts scheduled. I propose we repurpose that headcount to a Senior Edge Inference Engineer (same level, slightly different scope).

Why:
- Product timeline: new SDK customers committed to Q2 integration; we need infra expertise for quantization and edge runtimes.
- Little to no ramp cost vs. hiring fresh; faster to market if we reuse the open slot.

What I need from you:
1) Neha — quick read on active candidate pipeline for REQ-824 and whether there are live offers / acceptances (attachment: open-reqs-visibility-2026-12.xlsx).
2) Rachel / Lauren — verify comp band alignment if title/scope shifts (attachment: comp-band-grid-Q4-2026.pdf). If this requires band stretch, how do we handle approvals?
3) Vivek — any objections from a headcount/budget POV?

If we can move forward this week we can avoid opening a new req and shave ~6 weeks off schedule. I attached a draft offer template for the Edge role to illustrate banding.

Thanks —
Marcus
Senior Product Manager, Inference
Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Repurpose senior infra req to Edge Inference — comp band & approvals

Thanks Marcus — makes sense from a product timeline perspective. Two quick items before we commit:

- Neha: do we have any candidate with an outstanding offer on REQ-824? If so, we need to decide whether to convert that offer/role or honor the current scope.
- Lauren: if the new Edge scope pushes comp > band midpoint, please advise on escalation path (VP sign-off, etc.).

If the pipeline is clear (no live offer/acceptance), I am supportive of repurposing the slot and instructing recruiting to update the req description. If there is an active candidate, we should consider a) converting the candidate to the Edge position (if they accept the scope change) or b) closing that req and opening a new one — prefer (a) to keep timeline.

Neha — can you share candidate statuses and ETA to update the ATS?

— Rachel
Director, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Repurpose senior infra req to Edge Inference — comp band & approvals

Quick update on REQ-824 pipeline:
- One active candidate (Samir Patel, external) currently has a verbal offer in flight; we shared initial comp at band midpoint and he asked for a 7% increase (candidate email: samir@edge.ai).
- Two other screened candidates in the funnel (phone screen stage) with 1–2 week availability.

Options:
A) Convert the current candidate to the edge-focused role and present the updated JD + offer (I attached offer-draft-edge-inference.docx). Samir responded positively to the product vision but flagged comp as the sticking point.
B) Pause the current candidate (withdraw offer) and re-open a new req — higher risk of losing timeline and candidate goodwill.

If leadership prefers option A, I recommend we either:
- Approve a one-time band stretch to meet candidate expectations (Vivek / Lauren sign-off), or
- Hold firm at midpoint and counter with signing bonus / RSU mix to bridge gap.

I can run the updated offer language and comps within 24 hours if we get sign-off.

Neha
Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Repurpose senior infra req to Edge Inference — comp band & approvals

Thanks for the background. HR comp guidance:
- For lateral repurposes (same headcount level), we generally keep the existing band. Exceptions (band stretch beyond midpoint) require VP approval.
- Approvals path: Recruiting -> HR (comp sign-off) -> Finance -> VP People or VP Eng depending on dollar impact.
- If you want to avoid formal stretch approval, consider a mix of smaller salary + sign-on/RSU to reach total comp target.

Per policy, I can sign off up to midpoint immediately. For anything > midpoint, please route the request to Vivek with justification (candidate scarcity, timeline risk, strategic importance). I've linked the Jira change ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HRREQ-421 — please update the ticket with the proposed new title and justification so HR can process the repurpose.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. People Partner, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Repurpose senior infra req to Edge Inference — comp band & approvals

Appreciate the context. Conditional approval from finance/headcount:
- I authorize repurposing REQ-824 to Senior Edge Inference Engineer provided the total headcount budget remains neutral for Q1 and we do not exceed the band midpoint without explicit VP approval.
- If the candidate requires > midpoint, provide a short memo: business need, candidate scarcity, expected impact to roadmap; I will review and respond within 24 hours.

If Neha can draft the converted offer (including sign-on / equity mix option) and update HRREQ-421, proceed to present to the candidate.

— Vivek
VP, Finance & Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@edge.ai>, Karen Lee <karen@staffingplus.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Repurpose senior infra req to Edge Inference — comp band & approvals

All — decision: proceed with repurposing REQ-824 to Senior Edge Inference Engineer. Neha, please:
1) Pause the existing verbal counter until we have the adjusted offer language ready.
2) Convert the req in the ATS (update title, JD, and link to HRREQ-421) and share the updated offer (use sign-on / RSU mix to bridge the 7% ask if necessary; stay at or below midpoint unless Vivek OKs stretch).
3) Loop me in when you send the candidate the formal offer; I will join the offer call if Samir wants to discuss product scope.

Samir / Karen — thanks for your patience; we expect to share a formal updated offer within 24 hours.

— Rachel
Director, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
